integrity: All-dimensional proof with normalization, exact erasure nullity and spectral decomposition; finite independent numerical Gram tests are corroboration, not certification. No independent audit.
limitations: Only exact-degree-two harmonics, full tangent gradient observations and equal weights at surviving regular-simplex vertices; arbitrary partial gradient coordinates and higher degrees excluded. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp one-erasure gradient frames for quadratic spherical harmonics on regular simplices
